desc.ja: 結晶構造から、欠陥と拡散、機械的性質、状態図、熱処理までを順に学びます。金属材料を中心に、材料科学の基本の流れを一通りたどる最初の一歩におすすめです。
desc.en: Work through crystal structures, defects and diffusion, mechanical properties, phase diagrams and heat treatment in order. Centered on metals, it is a recommended first step that traces the basic arc of materials science from start to finish.

name.ja: 材料分析・故障解析の基礎
name.en: Fundamentals of materials characterization and failure analysis

desc.ja: 結晶構造と欠陥・拡散の基礎から、薄膜と表面の現象、XRD・SEM・TEM・XPS・SIMSなどの分析法までを学びます。プロセスや故障解析の業務で分析結果を読み解く力をつけたい人に向いています。
desc.en: Learn the basics of crystal structures, defects and diffusion, thin-film and surface phenomena, and analytical methods such as XRD, SEM, TEM, XPS and SIMS. Suited to anyone who wants to build the skill of interpreting analytical results in process engineering or failure analysis work.
